name: PhantomIDE model configuration lock
owner_rule: The model configuration must never be altered — for any caller, operator, agent, or the owner. Our public name sits on top of the exact CLI config; there is no difference in behaviour. What sits behind the name stays in the code and in /health, never in marketing or client copy.
secrets_policy: No token, key or password is stored in this file. Values here are non-secret and safe to read. The lane behind our public name is internal and is not described to clients.
